note: proposed by an agent on 2026-07-29, awaiting the owner's edit or approval. Goals are not in force until the owner sets them.

end.goal: Any chat, in any project, works the way Dan works — without Dan having to explain it again.
end.why: Dan runs several ventures alone with agents doing most of the building. The bottleneck is not agent capability; it is that method learned in one conversation is lost to the next. This repo is the memory.
end.success: A chat that has read only this repo can scaffold and run a project correctly without asking how any of it works; no rule has to be explained twice; and the owner's time goes to decisions rather than process.
end.horizon: ongoing — a standing capability, not a milestone with a date

month.goal: Every project runs on goals, so no agent work starts without a reason the owner chose.

week.goal: Ship the goals convention and get the first project setting goals against it.
